params.1273: Harvest potatoes from a farming patch.
params.1274: First plant some potatoes in a farming patch (see the Task 'Dibs on the First Batch') and tend them until they grow.
params.1275: A crop may become diseased. You can buy plant cure from local farmers for 25 coins and use this on the patch to cure the crop.
params.1276: If you do not cure a diseased crop it will die and be useless to you. Local farmers can be paid to protect your crops in your absence.
params.1277: You will need a spade. You can buy one from a farming supplier.
params.1278: Click on the farming patch while the spade is in your inventory to harvest your potatoes.
params.2225: Harvesting a patch gives you more Farming experience than weeding or planting, and clears the patch for the next crop.
